name: dzencode-inventory
description: SPA Orders & Products: Next.js + Redux Toolkit client, Express + Socket.io + MySQL API, Docker

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
